keep_features.feature_value: Uses disparaging slur-like term toward Republicans ('thugs')
keep_features.rationale: Contains derogatory language directed at a political actor.

keep_features.feature_value: Implicates resolving gun control vs Constitution through the stated principle
keep_features.evidence_span: "shall not be infringed" just... settle any gun control argument definitively
keep_features.rationale: Frames the citation as a decisive resolution to a policy debate.

keep_features.feature_value: Structured quotes with speaker labels (movement/policymakers back-and-forth)
keep_features.evidence_span:
Women's rights movement:

"Women deserve a seat at the table."
keep_features.rationale: Uses embedded quoted dialogue to build an argument.

keep_features.feature_value: Anti-conservative framing of ideology with disguise/hood imagery
keep_features.evidence_span: "conservative agenda with the masks off and hoods on"
keep_features.rationale: Uses metaphor associated with political culture-war/identity narratives.

keep_features.feature_value: Blames Democrats for conforming to a rival leader's narrative vs 'reasonable ones'
keep_features.evidence_span: "Republican party has changed"... "fit the Trump narrative"
keep_features.rationale: Uses in-group/out-group contrast anchored in leader-narrative alignment.

keep_features.feature_value: Depicts women as harmed/alone after abortion pill, emphasizing aftermath
keep_features.evidence_span: "It kills them, and leaves women to deliver their dead children alone"
keep_features.rationale: Frames affected individuals as victims suffering severe harm.

keep_features.feature_value: Characterizes opponents with extreme derogatory descriptors ('cancer ridden', 'Nazi')
keep_features.rationale: Uses mocking/extreme comparative insults for persuasion.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct rhetorical question about constitutional application
keep_features.evidence_span: "How can all of our gun laws only be constitutional if..."
keep_features.rationale: Uses a question to challenge and argue rather than request information.

remove_features.feature_value: Frames wrongdoing as selectively excused based on party (GOP vs Democrats)
remove_features.evidence_span: "It’s only illegal when a no-good, evil commie democrat does it"
remove_features.rationale: Calls out perceived retaliatory/biased treatment of election fraud allegations.

remove_features.feature_value: Calls actor coward/mentally ill/bully and claims other party enables it
remove_features.evidence_span: "He's a coward, mentally ill, a bully."
remove_features.rationale: Uses highly charged insults plus blame attribution.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses policy/tech domain terms and ideological labels (eco-fascist, electrification, renewables)
remove_features.rationale: Contains specialized climate-policy terminology and loaded ideological descriptor.

remove_features.feature_value: Capitalized slogan-like terms in quoted list (sanctity of marriage/family/faith-based lifestyle)
remove_features.rationale: Uses a condensed slogan list; quoted phrases indicate a rhetorical template.
